---
name: Feature or coverage request
about: Suggest additional read-only audit coverage or agent compatibility
title: "enhancement: "
---

## Problem or missing evidence
Which repository state, agent, forge, platform, or workflow is inadequately observable today?

## Proposed behavior
Describe the smallest useful capability and its expected output classification. A feature request is **not** evidence that functionality is already implemented.

## Scope and safety
- Applicable repositories / agents:
- Read-only by default? State any exceptional permission:
- Evidence sources and trust boundaries:
- Resource/performance limits:
- Expected false positives and unknown/unobservable cases:
- Interaction with Standard versus Full and opt-in scanners:

## Acceptance criteria
Describe a minimal public/sanitized fixture and the evidence needed to call the change complete. Keep physical-device or native-agent acceptance separate from CI success.

## Alternatives / related work
Link existing issues/PRs or reference documents if relevant. Do not assume related work is duplicate work without comparing deliverables and acceptance criteria.

Do not submit credentials, full private source, local user paths, or unredacted reports in public issues.
